summary: Valion Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of Series B and Series C preferred shares and warrants to 3i, LP. The company agreed to issue 100 Series B Preferred Shares, 7,637 Series C Preferred Shares, and warrants to purchase 3,077 and 1,053,969 common shares at $3.62 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of $7,737,000. The closing purchase price includes $6,137,000 retained by 3i to satisfy overdue cash true-up obligations. The filing does not constitute a special situation; it is a routine financing and compensatory arrangement.
